title: Magnetically retrievable carbon-wrapped CNT/Ni nanospheres as efficient catalysts for nitroaromatic reduction
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,38605-38614
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07815B, Paper

Sumaya Nur Mithila, Akter Hossain Reaz, Fatema Zerin Farhana, Muhammad J. A. Shiddiky, Shakhawat H. Firoz
A simple approach is developed to synthesize carbon-wrapped CNT/Ni nanospheres with magnetic retrievability, significantly improving catalytic performance for reducing environmental pollutants.
